title: She was born in Mumbai, trained as an engineer. In 2026, she became dean of a top US nursing school.

sources.text: The Week (PTI) - Mumbai-born engineer-scientist named interim dean of UT Austin School of Nursing
American Bazaar - Kavita Radhakrishnan becomes Dean of Texas nursing school

caption:
She was born in Mumbai, trained as an engineer. In 2026, she became dean of a top US nursing school.

Mumbai-born, she earned her bachelor's in electronics engineering from the University of Mumbai before moving to the US, later earning a PhD in Nursing Science and joining UT Austin's faculty in 2012.

In 2025, she was inducted into the Sigma Theta Tau International Nurse Researcher Hall of Fame - and much of her research specifically targets culturally-tailored health interventions for South Asian communities.

Radhakrishnan's path - engineering to nursing science to dean - is a reminder that Indian STEM training opens doors far beyond the field someone first trained in.
